Store build metadata of single binary builds

store_build_metadata.Rd

Store build metadata of single binary builds

Usage

store_build_metadata(
  package_name,
  tag,
  platform,
  error_occurred,
  arch,
  force = FALSE,
  error = NA,
  build_duration = NA,
  size = NA
)

Arguments

package_name

(character)
Package name

tag

(character)
Tag/version

platform

(character)
Platform identifier

error_occurred

(logical)
Whether or not an error occurred during build

arch

(character)
Architecture

force

(logical)
Whether to force-build packages

error

(character)
Error information

build_duration

Duration of binary build

size

Size of binary package
